source_file: twin-shot-venom.html (owner-supplied "TWINSHOT — Venom FX Lab", kept local, not committed or distributed; gitignored at the repository root)
card: [SP1] T-18792e32 Scrag spit: replace with the supplied twin-shot venom effect
assets: none: the source is procedural geometry and shaders ("No image assets"); nothing was extracted as a file
source_layout: the effect's ES module is one JavaScript string literal on source line 79 (`const source="..."`), imported as a blob; the names below are inside it

taken.streamWindow(): ported verbatim as the exported streamWindow (motion of the spit packet); tests/venom_test.js runs the source's own copy against it
taken.STREAM_VERTEX: thickness() and main() verbatim; per-stream uniforms became instance attributes, the local frame is built from the stream direction, positions stay in source metres until scaled into the world by `unit`; plus a minimum on-screen width (port addition, see doc)
taken.LIQUID_FRAGMENT: verbatim apart from the two light directions turned from y-up to Quake z-up, premultiplied output and zeroed G-buffer outputs; the source's ACES tone-mapping include is not used (Quaked grades the frame itself; measured colour matched without it)
taken.DROP_VERTEX: the instance matrix (direction-aligned, scale r, r*stretch, r) and its normal transform, rebuilt from per-instance position/direction attributes
taken.SPLAT_VERTEX / SPLAT_FRAGMENT: fragment verbatim apart from instanced age/seed and premultiplied output; the quad is oriented on the struck surface with its v axis down the surface
taken.DropletPool: the fixed-capacity ring pool (900 at quality high) with emit/update rules, as typed arrays
taken.TwinVenomFX._jetDroplets: 125 per second per stream, radius .004-.010 m, stretch 1.7-5.5, offsets +-.038 / +-.024 m
taken.TwinVenomFX._splash: 30 on impact plus 85 per second while the stream drains; radius .009-.025 m, stretch 1.1-2.9, life .28-.8 s, gravity 5.3 m/s^2
taken.TwinVenomFX._stain: size .58-.74 m, life 4.4 s, growth .28 to 1 over .065 s, offset .012 m, at most 24
taken.TwinVenomFX._step / update: the stream window, impact, droplet production and the 1/90 s substeps
taken.twinPlan defaults: speed 22 m/s, duration .28 s, radius .015 m

not_taken.startLab(): the playground (cobra, target board, floor grid, UI, chat commands, camera) is the source's demo scene, not the effect
not_taken.twinPlan origins / fang sockets: since card [SP2] each stream starts at a fang on the Scrag's face: the jaw corner of id1 progs/wizard.mdl (vertex 52, the frame drawn) with the source demo's fang sockets 0.13 m either side, on the side the native spike left from
not_taken.twinPlan lanes / simultaneous pair: the native Scrag already fires two projectiles from either side of its mouth at two points either side of the player; each native projectile is one lane, and their 0.5 s spacing is gameplay timing, kept
not_taken.collisionTest / onLaunch / onImpact: collisions, damage and events stay the server's (QuakeC spike_touch, TE_WIZSPIKE)

scale: 1 source metre = 600 / 22 = 27.27 Quake units (native wizspike speed over the source jet speed): all timings are the source's
